request.brief: Haber-Bosch Ammonia, Germany circa 1913. Synthetic ammonia research reduces imported nitrate dependence. One massive vertical early-industrial cylindrical steel pressure vessel with a short brass gauge and two thick curved pipes integral to its base, shown as a single coherent apparatus. Broad simple shapes, large readable silhouette, no laboratory retort or glass flask, no tiny industrial scenery. Smooth deep amber-brown enamel square backplate with clipped corners and a precise cool pewter bevel, narrow warm inner trim. Clean contemporary vanilla Paradox focus rendering, smooth sculpted relief, crisp highlights and deep clean shadow, no rust, scratches, grain, mottled patina or painterly flecks. Central apparatus fills most of the opaque frame at 100×88. Transparent exterior only, small clean margin. No text, gauge numerals, flags, maps, poison gas imagery, modern electronics or floating overlays.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV national focus icon: Haber-Bosch Ammonia, Germany circa 1913. Synthetic ammonia research reduces imported nitrate dependence. One massive vertical early-industrial cylindrical steel pressure vessel with a short brass gauge and two thick curved pipes integral to its base, shown as a single coherent apparatus. Broad simple shapes, large readable silhouette, no laboratory retort or glass flask, no tiny industrial scenery. Smooth deep amber-brown enamel square backplate with clipped corners and a precise cool pewter bevel, narrow warm inner trim. Clean contemporary vanilla Paradox focus rendering, smooth sculpted relief, crisp highlights and deep clean shadow, no rust, scratches, grain, mottled patina or painterly flecks. Central apparatus fills most of the opaque frame at 100×88. Transparent exterior only, small clean margin. No text, gauge numerals, flags, maps, poison gas imagery, modern electronics or floating overlays.

Requirements:
- Take the frame, outline and overall form from the style anchor images, not from a fixed family form; the size, transparency, margin and readability requirements here still apply.
- Flags and ribbons use invented colours, never a real country's flag, unless the brief names that country.
- The subject is large: it fills most of the emblem and may overlap its frame, never a small figure inside a wide empty plaque.
- A strong central symbol that supports the focus's story, readable contrast at 100x88 pixels.
- Real transparent background around the emblem: no backdrop behind it.
- Leave a small empty margin around the emblem.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a square backdrop behind the subject.

Produce exactly one image.
negative: a square backdrop behind the subject
